S2.4.6 states depth-l values lie in 2^-(p+l) Z[i] with modulus at most 2^l so p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer/sign bits represent every coefficient exactly, and S2.4.7 gives epsilon*C_1<1 hence Delta=o(p).

summary: 25 of 26 sub-steps present, 0 wrong, 1 absent (P4). The plan carries the bank-exchange, residual-table, label-budget, rank-saving, matrix-shear and guard-width derivations in detail; only the complex-interface endpoint repair (frames I and C^{otimes m}, Z_{a,k} before and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} after on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), negated X outputs) is merely named in S2.1.3 without its content. L2 (containment <t_X> in t_Y-perp compressed into 'possible because'), L4 (absorbing alternating planes not spelled out) and P2 (H diag(1,-1) H = X only implied) are borderline but credited as present.
